supersedes.reason: v1 passed every learned capacity metric but its mathematically symmetric leave-one-out logsumexp lost about 7e-4 float32 precision when one edge dominated; v2 computes the selected winner denominator by explicit masking while retaining exactly the same model, data, objective, seed, endpoint and gates

purpose: authoritative synthetic-only plumbing check for the materially new joint outgoing/incoming tri-emitter verifier

no_repeat_contract.retained: unchanged vectorized tri-emitter ordered raw seam, DINO boundary and scalar auxiliary content backbone
no_repeat_contract.new: one sparse assignment objective jointly supervises outgoing rows, incoming columns, explicit NONE and calibrated two-sided confidence
forbidden: real FIT, DEV or terminal scoring

fixed_architecture.learned_none: separate row and column scalar logits per axis

fixed_objective.confidence_label: exact directed edge truth for every valid candidate including row winners, column winners and many-to-one collisions
fixed_objective.two_sided_margin: edge logit minus logsumexp of all other valid assignments including learned NONE, separately for row and column
fixed_objective.confidence_calibration: learned bias and positive softplus temperature with minimum 0.001

fixed_deployment_head.rule: reciprocal row-top1 and column-top1 then calibrated two-sided confidence descending
fixed_deployment_head.tie_break: confidence descending, source identity ascending, target identity ascending

capacity.construction: matched ordered boundary content plus a raw-favoured many-to-one collision target on each axis

numerical_repair_only.v1_formula: leave-one-out logsumexp via log(exp(total)-exp(edge)) for every edge
numerical_repair_only.v2_formula: same expression for non-winners; explicitly mask the selected argmax before logsumexp for the sole cancellation-prone winner
